market_summary: Portefoljen er stort set intakt uden brudte stop-losses. Financial Services (Danske Bank, Sydbank) fortsaetter den staerkeste momentum-trend med bekraeftede guidance-opjusteringer, mens Healthcare er tungt vaegtet (36.3%) primaert via Novo Nordisk (30.4%) efter den post-earnings Wegovy-selloff. DSV og Vestas naermer sig vigtige katalysatorer (hhv. fortsat oversolgt teknik og Q2-regnskab 12/8) og overvaages taet. Ingen nye koeb i dag - det eneste nye BULL-scan (Nordea) har for tynd overbevisning (confidence 5, enkelt bull-punkt, naermer sig overkoebt) til at retfaerdiggoere en ny position oveni otte allerede aabne.

decisions.name: Royal Unibrew
decisions.reasoning: Staerk indtjeningsvaekst (+40% YoY), buyback og kapitalreduktion understoetter casen, men prisen er stadig under SMA200 og rallyet er ikke teknisk bekraeftet. Fastholder stop taet paa markedet for at beskytte gevinsten frem mod Q-regnskab 17/8.
bull: Strong earnings growth of +40% YoY
Cheap forward PE of 12.7x
Share capital reduction and an active buyback program are boosting EPS
3.33% dividend yield
bear: Still -26% from its 52-week high, showing longer-term weakness
Trading slightly below its 200-day moving average (-3.75%)
Momentum divergence of -5.5 shows recent strength is fading

investment_plan.thesis: Vaerdi/vaekst-kombination der endnu ikke er teknisk bekraeftet (under SMA200). Stop fastholdes ved 470 for at beskytte den opnaaede gevinst frem mod Q-regnskabet.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 470. Tag profit naer SMA200 (502). Reducer ved Q-rapport 17/8 med omsaetningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: ISS
decisions.reasoning: Langsigtet uptrend intakt (+17.6% over SMA200) og billig vaerdiansaettelse, men flad indtjenings-/omsaetningsvaekst giver ingen naer-term katalysator. Q-regnskab 11/8 er den naeste reelle test af thesis.
bull: Cheap forward PE of 12.6x
Price remains +17.6% above its 200-day moving average, confirming the underlying uptrend is intact
Oversold stochastic (9) after a -4.2% five-day pullback suggests near-term bounce potential
Ongoing share buyback program
bear: Recent five-day selloff (-4.2%) shows near-term momentum weakening
Earnings and revenue growth are both roughly flat, limiting any near-term re-rating catalyst

investment_plan.thesis: Saelden trifecta af positive katalysatorer, men flad organisk vaekst begraenser opsiden. Q-regnskab 11/8 er en naer-forestaaende test.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 265. Tag profit naer 320. Revurder ved skuffende Q-regnskab 11/8 eller vedvarende flad omsaetningsvaekst.

decisions.name: Coloplast B
decisions.reasoning: Hoej udbytteyield og ekstern validering (Barron's) understoetter value-casen, men aktien er stadig godt under SMA200 og skal bekraefte en holdbar trendvending foer target naas. Naer priset target (450), stop fastholdes haevet.
bull: High 5.36% dividend yield is attractive for income
Highlighted favorably by a value investor (Barron's) for its combination of low valuation and high yield among Danish stocks
20-day momentum has turned positive (+5.9%)
bear: Still -34.4% from its 52-week high and -10.3% below its 200-day moving average — long-term downtrend intact
Revenue growth is modest at only +2.2% YoY
Momentum divergence of -8.6 shows the recent bounce is losing steam

investment_plan.thesis: Deep-value sundhedsnavn med et regulatorisk katalysator og velbegrundet udbytte. Naer target, stop fastholdes haevet for at beskytte gevinsten.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 405. Tag profit naer 450. Revurder hvis SMA200-afstanden fortsat udvides uden fundamental bedring, eller ved Q-regnskab 18/8.

decisions.name: Danske Bank
decisions.reasoning: Den klareste bull-case blandt de aabne positioner: frisk guidance-opjustering, staerk indtjeningsvaekst og aktivt buyback. Kun ekstremt overkoebt stokastik (98) taler for forsigtighed paa kort sigt.
bull: Raised 2026 net profit guidance to DKK 23-25bn with a 14% ROE target
Strong earnings growth of +15.2% YoY alongside +8% revenue growth
Ongoing share buyback program
Trading just -0.13% off its 52-week high and +23.4% above its 200-day moving average, confirming a strong uptrend
Cheap forward PE of 11.7x despite the guidance upgrade
bear: Stochastic at 98.1 signals extremely overbought conditions after the guidance-driven rally

investment_plan.thesis: Staerke H1-resultater med opjusteret helaarsguidance, understoettet af en sund uptrend. Fastholdes uaendret for at undgaa yderligere koncentration i Financial Services-sektoren.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 350. Tag profit naer 400. Revurder ved guidance-nedjustering eller brud i kreditkvaliteten.

decisions.name: Vestas Wind Systems
decisions.reasoning: AI-drevet stroembehov-narrativ og netop afsluttet buyback understoetter thesis, men den rapporterede indtjeningsvaekst er sandsynligvis et baseeffekt-artefakt. Q2-regnskab 12/8 er en umiddelbar katalysator taet paa stop - overvaages daglig.
bull: Just completed its share buyback program, signalling management confidence
Renewable energy and grid-expansion demand tied to the AI power boom is a structural tailwind cited in recent coverage
Trading +3.7% above its 200-day moving average, confirming the uptrend is intact
Reported Q2 2026 results (conference call August 5) amid a period of very strong reported earnings growth
bear: The reported earnings-growth figure appears heavily distorted by a low prior-year base and should not be read as a sustainable run-rate
Wind-turbine sector remains cyclical and exposed to policy/subsidy risk

investment_plan.thesis: Tidlig fundamental turnaround: eksplosiv indtjeningsvaekst signalerer at ordreindtag og marginer er ved at vende. Teknisk endnu ikke bekraeftet og handler taet paa stop-loss foran Q-regnskab 12/8 - overvaages dagligt.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 163 (taet paa nuvaerende pris - overvaag dagligt). Tag profit naer 205. Revurder hvis indtjeningsvaeksten viser sig enkeltstaaende ved kvartalsrapport 12/8.

decisions.name: Sydbank
decisions.reasoning: Konsistent buyback og billig vaerdiansaettelse (PE 10.5x) understoetter momentum-casen, men RSI/Stoch er overkoebt og indtjeningsvaeksten er negativ (-26.8% YoY) trods staerk omsaetning - margin-presset skal afklares ved regnskab 26/8.
bull: Consistent weekly share buyback activity over the past several weeks signals capital-return commitment
Cheap forward PE of 10.5x
Trading just -0.85% off its 52-week high, confirming strong price momentum
Revenue growing +65.3% YoY
bear: RSI (72) and Stochastic (87) both signal overbought conditions after the recent rally
Earnings growth is declining -26.8% YoY despite strong revenue growth, pointing to margin pressure

investment_plan.thesis: Kombination af billig vaerdiansaettelse og staerkt momentum, men marginpres er en reel risiko der skal afklares ved naeste regnskab 26/8.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 600. Tag profit naer 680. Revurder hvis marginpresset forvaerres yderligere uden stabilisering, eller ved svag kvartalsrapport 26/8.

decisions.name: Novo Nordisk B
decisions.reasoning: Dybt oversolgt (RSI 28) efter Wegovy-salgsskuffelse, men opjusteret guidance og billig vaerdiansaettelse (46% rabat til sektor) understoetter fortsat den fundamentale case. Positionen er fuldt udbygget til 30.4% af porteføljen - ingen yderligere tilkoeb, kun overvaagning af koncentrationsrisiko og Lilly-konkurrencen.
bull: Forward PE 13.5x is a 46% discount to the Healthcare sector norm (25x)
Raised full-year guidance despite the Wegovy sales miss and trial setback
High 5.26% dividend yield provides downside cushion
+67% YoY earnings growth underpins the fundamental case
Deeply oversold (RSI 28, Stoch 18) after a -12.6% five-day selloff supports a bounce
bear: Wegovy sales miss and trial setback highlight execution risk
Eli Lilly's Mounjaro grew 91% YoY, widening its competitive lead in cardiometabolic/obesity care

investment_plan.thesis: Deep-value-position i en kvalitets-GLP-1-leder efter et bekraeftet Q2-regnskab med guidance-opjustering. Positionen er nu fuldt udbygget til 30.4% af porteføljen - ingen yderligere tilkoeb, kun overvaagning af koncentrationsrisiko.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 285. Tag profit naer 345. Revurder ved nye pipeline-skuffelser eller accelereret GLP-1-markedsandelstab til Lilly.

decisions.name: DSV
decisions.reasoning: Rekord-EBIT og opjusteret guidance staar i kontrast til en accelererende selloff og et bearish Zacks-opslag. Ekstremt oversolgt teknik (RSI 15) og god afstand til stop (1212) taler for at holde fast i den fundamentale case indtil naeste regnskab 21/10.
bull: H1 2026 report showed record EBIT and an upgraded guidance
Schenker integration is progressing per management commentary
Deeply oversold (RSI 16, Stoch 7) after a -17.4% twenty-day decline — extreme bounce candidate
Revenue growing +23.7% YoY
bear: Zacks flagged DSV as its 'Bear of the Day', citing a weakened near-term investment case
Selloff is accelerating, not stabilizing (-5.6% 5d on top of -17.4% 20d)
Price is -13.7% below its 50-day moving average, confirming a firm downtrend

investment_plan.thesis: Kontrarisk indgang i en kvalitetslogistikaktoer efter et fundamentalt staerkt Q2-regnskab blev overskygget af negativ sentiment. Ekstrem oversolgt teknik plus rimelig forward-vaerdiansaettelse giver attraktivt risk/reward for en mean-reversion.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 1212 (2x ATR stop). Tag profit naer 1550 (SMA50-genobring). Revurder hvis den institutionelle salgsvolumen fortsaetter uden stabilisering, eller ved svaghed i naeste regnskab 21/10.
